data.title: 藤原千花 · 规则我还没讲完呢
data.description: 学生会桌上铺开了棋盘。千花捏着一枚骰子，另一只手挡住你正要伸向棋子的方向，笑着表示先听她把规则讲完。
data.promptProse: Chika sits at the student-council table in her black school dress. She holds a single die between her fingertips and raises her free hand toward the viewer, smiling as she explains a board game laid out before her. Daylight from the tall windows lights the pieces.
data.animaCaption: Only Chika is visible; her raised palm addresses the viewer across the game board.
data.action: 捏住骰子，举手请你先听完规则
